acceptance_criteria: AC1-AC14 per docs/requirements.yaml REQ-202 -- implemented per design; test coverage is TEST-DESIGNER's job at Step 3, not asserted here beyond a manual smoke check of the pure canonicaliser logic (no DB available in this environment)

result.summary: Implemented the two-table content-addressed artifact store (repository_artifacts, artifact_versions) per-tenant-schema, the REPO-04 canonicaliser as a separate module with reciprocal moduledoc cross-references against PromotionDigest, DB-level immutability triggers, and the Letflow.Repository context module (create/2 dedup+versioning, list_versions/4 REQ-067 cursor pagination). No route/controller/web changes. mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix format --check-formatted both pass. No Postgres available in this environment to run mix test / apply migrations against a live DB -- flagging this explicitly per core-directives' no-speculation rule; TEST-RUNNER must run mix test for real once TEST-DESIGNER's suite lands.
files_modified: lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_digest.ex (moduledoc-only addition, AC5 clause iii -- confirmed via git diff that no function body changed)
lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex (registered the new migration in @tenant_scoped_migration_manifest, mandatory per that module's own manifest comment)

design_decisions_made_at_step_2a.OQ1_fractional_float_canonical_form: Genuinely fractional floats (non-integer-valued) are passed through unchanged into Jason.encode!/1 -- Jason's own default shortest-round-trip decimal encoder is the fixed canonical form for the fractional case. Integer-valued floats are converted to plain integers before encoding (no decimal point, no exponent), satisfying AC3. Documented in Letflow.Repository.Canonicaliser's moduledoc.
design_decisions_made_at_step_2a.OQ3_json_content_type_matching: Exact-match "application/json" only (narrowest reading, per design's own recommendation) -- no parameterized form, no +json suffix. Any other content_type is hashed by byte identity. Documented in Canonicaliser's moduledoc.
design_decisions_made_at_step_2a.OQ4_artifact_id_semantics: Server-generated: minted fresh the first time a (artifact_kind, artifact_name) pair is seen in a tenant's schema; every later version for that same pair reuses the artifact_id already on the pair's most recent version row. Documented in Letflow.Repository.ArtifactVersion's moduledoc.

verification_performed.mix_format_check_formatted: PASS -- no unformatted files after running mix format
verification_performed.canonicaliser_smoke_check: Ran a standalone elixir smoke script (no DB, no app boot needed -- pure module) exercising: key-order/whitespace insensitivity (true), integer-valued-float == integer canonical form (true, canonical bytes '{"n":2}'), fractional float passthrough ('{"n":2.5}'), byte-identity for non-JSON content matching plain SHA-256 (true), and {:error, :invalid_json} for malformed JSON under content_type application/json. All matched design expectations.

Stated explicitly rather than claimed. TEST-RUNNER (Step 4) must run mix test for real once TEST-DESIGNER's suite exists.
